ece955b7ae2c6f174240be0acb70f94d74669bb8.LogDescription: Recover 6 Fizzcrank Pilot Insignia from the bodies of Fizzcrank Recon Pilots and return them to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Scalding Pools.
ece955b7ae2c6f174240be0acb70f94d74669bb8.QuestDescription: Injured or not, as squadron commander, I'm responsible for locating and returning the insignia of all fallen pilots under my command. In all the years I've flown with Fizzcrank, we've never failed to return the signet of a pilot.$B$BMy injuries make it dangerous for me to stray far from the safety of the wreckage, but perhaps you would be willing to help me recover the insignia? In the meantime, I'll make preparations to carry out my final duty as squadron commander.

ecf6a0907ff21541b21af614902018da6e2636be.LogDescription: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
ecf6a0907ff21541b21af614902018da6e2636be.QuestDescription: $N, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!$B$BLong ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian," after the hydra god.$B$BI did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?$B$BI even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!

ecf7eab38e4bf719be062ad6e3219b85cad608a8.Text: [Furbolg] Come, $n. Let us leave the water together, purified.

ecf9ab16ddab0dbbcc1295d06e9e5b537541adc9.Text: What have you done,  Isillien? You once fought with honor, for the good of our people... and now... you have murdered my boy...

ecfbe871e1b4e0c57f9274e8c4261103a357271a.Text: Did you think that your betrayal would be forgotten? Lost in the carefully planned cover up of my death? Blood of my blood, the blade felt your cruelty long after my heart had stopped beating. And in death, I knew what you had done. But now, the chains of Kel'thuzad hold me no more. I come to serve justice. I AM ASHBRINGER.

ecfca268f54bdc2e17addc68b9aedabc90c84fab.LogDescription: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
ecfca268f54bdc2e17addc68b9aedabc90c84fab.QuestDescription: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.$B$BThey may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.$B$BTheir first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.

ecfd5842d52f49af7272a33548522bc83928eef1.LogDescription: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
ecfd5842d52f49af7272a33548522bc83928eef1.QuestDescription: Oh my!  Oh my!  There is a doom approaching.  Mark me!  A doom!$B$BNo, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me!  But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!$B$BMaybe.$B$BGo into Uldaman.  No!  I said it!  You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh.  Yes, find it!  And don't make me speak that name again!$B$BIt is deep in that place, in an ancient chest.  That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.
